question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated?
premises: The vital air is filled with breath.
This air is described as situated.
Its location is in all living beings.
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam may reflect transmitted text.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
